translations.answer: The root cause is that `apply_nested` stops drilling down after the first successful link, skipping nested sub-links. The PR #6377 adds `stop_on_success` to the decorator, and rigid-body/mass writers use `stop_on_success=False` by default; the default remains true to avoid unintended schema behavior changes. Validation should not only check the cfg, but also traverse all rigid bodies and verify that `disableGravity` and `physics:mass` are covered in each link.
translations.applicability: Applies to the Isaac Sim 6.0 importer or custom USD with body-under-body nested hierarchy.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and there is no conflict, and it has been formally documented or independently reproducible with precise reference.
translations.details.attempts.0: PR #6377 adds a default `stop_on_success` to `apply_nested`, and rigid-body/mass writers explicitly set to false.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Traverse each stage, count the number of RigidBodyAPI, disableGravity, and PhysxContactReportAPI bodies covered.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Upgrade to a version containing PR #6377 and merge commit 10144da, and validate each nested body via stage traversal.
translations.details.environments.0: IsaacLab a4a7602f29 v3.0.0-beta 8ef1bf7a8b beta2, Isaac Sim 6.0.0-rc.22, Ubuntu 24.04, RTX 5090, CUDA 13.0, driver 580.159.03.
translations.details.limits.0: #6377 only relaxes early stop for rigid-body and mass writers; joint, articulation root, and collision writers still use default behavior.
translations.details.limits.1: Behaviors from previous versions of nested assets may affect the task after upgrade.
translations.details.outcomes.0: PR has been merged, and the 3/3 links in the nested rigid-body regression test assert `disableGravity` and `physics:mass` successfully.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why do nested URDF's rigid-body/mass spawn properties only affect the root link?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Do not only check the cfg; after spawn, audit each body's final USD/PhysX attributes, especially gravity, mass, contact report, and depenetration limits.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: `apply_nested` defaults to assuming the physics schema does not nest, and the wrapped function stops traversing children after the root link succeeds.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Only 1 out of 29 links gets `disable_gravity=True`, and the hand is about 0.2 m drooping; the contact report API is also 1/N, and the sub-link ContactSensor reports no reporter API found.
